usage.callShape: POST https://stableemail.dev/api/subdomain/send with JSON body {from:"you@<yoursubdomain>.stableemail.dev", to:["dest@example.com"], subject, text|html} — x402 paid ($0.005). Paying wallet MUST be the owner or an authorized signer of the subdomain.

inputExample.subject: MasterKey QA test - StableEmail
inputExample.text: Hello John, this is a MasterKey registry QA test message sent via StableEmail over x402.

usage.outputShape: body.success (bool), body.messageId, body.from on success; on failure body.success=false, body.error (e.g. "Subdomain not found")
quirks: RECIPIENT NON-DELIVERY CONFIRMED 2026-06-09: the user (john.doe@gmail.com) received NO email from this service during QA — corroborates broken/untested (do not mark verified on a paid 200 alone; this one did not actually deliver).
PREREQUISITE: you must OWN a subdomain on stableemail.dev. Buy it first via POST /api/subdomain/buy ($5, body {subdomain:'yourname'}); DNS verification takes ~5min.

The 'from' address MUST be on a subdomain you control (you@<yoursubdomain>.stableemail.dev). Using an unowned subdomain returns HTTP 404 {success:false, error:'Subdomain not found'} AND STILL CHARGES the $0.005 (charge-then-404).
The paying wallet must be the subdomain owner or an authorized signer (add signers free via POST /api/subdomain/signers).
Required fields: from, to (array, 1-50), subject. Must include 'text' or 'html' (or both).
No-prerequisite alternative: POST /api/send ($0.02) sends from relay@stableemail.dev with no owned subdomain needed (different endpoint, body has no 'from').
needs: An owned subdomain on stableemail.dev (purchased via POST /api/subdomain/buy, $5) with the QA wallet as owner or authorized signer
usage.guide: This endpoint sends a real email from a custom subdomain you own on stableemail.dev. Before using it you must purchase a subdomain via POST /api/subdomain/buy ($5) using the same wallet (or be an authorized signer); without an owned subdomain the call returns 404 'Subdomain not found' but still charges $0.005. Then POST a JSON body with from (you@yoursubdomain.stableemail.dev), to (array of recipients), subject, and text or html; x402 pays $0.005. On success read body.messageId and body.from. If you only need to send a one-off email without owning a subdomain, use POST /api/send ($0.02) instead, which sends from relay@stableemail.dev.
